items.title: Let skills in Gemini tackle your most repetitive tasks
items.summary: 这篇内容聚焦「Agent Skill、Harness、工具调用和自动化研发」。原文摘要显示：Now you can automate your most repetitive tasks more easily with reusable custom instructions through skills, which will be replacing gems.
items.insightText: 重点看任务拆分、工具编排、验证闭环和可复用工程抽象，判断能否迁移到 Auto-Research / Agent Coding 链路。
